quote:
ENDİNG SPOİLERS AHEAD!

story is all over the place. First of all story is trapping you in a bad relationship with a woman who is not a likeable character or even NOT doing her duty as mother of a baby. God...where is Grand theft auto story? WHERE İS my freedom to kill everyone else? well im not saying we couldve killed mission givers but WHY WE CANT KİLL A RANDOM CİTİZEN ON STREET. I didnt finish game but looked to endings on internet. isnt this game about killing people? reaching the top and badassly destroy everything else? like gta 5, san andreas, vice city and others. is THİS a gta? or you people just using ''GTA'' name to sell this literally a propaganda stuff. and second part is. This characters are two most emptied characters i've seen in my life. a souless guy who is ''okay'' to everything and ahh woman who thinks she is strong, special etc. Honestly i expected myself or even other people to simp on Lucia but NOT force Jason to Simp Lucia. And yeah. game is all about ''simping=good ending, not simping=bad ending'' i saw a comment which said ''game could've been better if you delete all missions and both characters in game and add customizable characters with full open world.'' now i agree. To be honest im really disappointed. but overall at least open world is awesome (i still hate that we cant kill random people who supposed to die and somehow it doesnt? and not able to do GRAND THEFT AUTO things to kill everyone in game.) but just ''awesome open world'' does not save this garbage story which is exist.
